name: NROL-136
destination_explanation: Being close to the ground is the point: signals arrive quickly and cameras see fine detail, which is why internet and imaging satellites settle here.
slot_a_text: Fifteenth batch of satellites for a reconnaissance satellite constellation built by SpaceX and Northrop Grumman for the National Reconnaissance Office to provide imaging and other reconnaissance capabilities.
slot_b_text: B1097 typically goes 30 days between flights, with a best of 14. On that form it should fly again around late December.
